notes: The same chain as carddemo-job-posttran-tranidx, with TRANIDX's RECORDSIZE(350,350) raised to (4400,4400). Why: the harness's POSTTRAN run stamps all 264 TRANFILE records with one processed timestamp (2022-07-18-10.30.15.000000, from the PARM date), so the non-unique alternate key 26/304 has ONE value shared by 264 records; BLDINDEX's record for that key holds 264 pointers (4255 bytes in the model) and the real deck's RECORDSIZE maximum of 350 cannot hold it (the real-deck case stops there, refused by name: IBM's outcome is not stated). On z/OS the timestamps differ, so the real deck's size is not the question there; this variant exists to compare the path in alternate-key order, all-duplicates, on model and Java. ASSUMED: the RECORDSIZE change only sizes the index record and does not change which records the path returns or their order (register F6). The oracle for IDCAMS is the model, not z/OS.
